import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def naive_search_precond (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  haystack.size < 1000000 ∧ 
  needle.size < 1000000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def allBytesEq (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) : Nat → Bool
  | 0 => true
  | k + 1 =>
      allBytesEq haystack needle i k &&
        (haystack.getD (i + k) 0 == needle.getD k 0)

def aux_matches_at (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size ∧
  (∀ j, j < needle.size → haystack.getD (i + j) 0 = needle.getD j 0)

def matchAtBool (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size) &&
    allBytesEq haystack needle i needle.size
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def naive_search (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (_ : naive_search_precond haystack needle) : Array Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  ((List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter
    (fun i => matchAtBool haystack needle i)).toArray
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition auxiliary definitions
def matches_at (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size ∧
  (∀ j, j < needle.size → haystack.getD (i + j) 0 = needle.getD j 0)

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def naive_search_postcond (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (result : Array Nat) (_ : naive_search_precond haystack needle) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ i, i < result.size → matches_at haystack needle (result.getD i 0)) ∧
  (∀ i, matches_at haystack needle i → ∃ k, k < result.size ∧ result.getD k 0 = i)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem allBytesEq_eq_true_iff (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i k : Nat) :
    allBytesEq haystack needle i k = true ↔
      ∀ j, j < k → haystack.getD (i + j) 0 = needle.getD j 0 := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      simp [allBytesEq]
  | succ k ih =>
      change
        (allBytesEq haystack needle i k &&
            (haystack.getD (i + k) 0 == needle.getD k 0)) = true ↔
          ∀ j, j < k + 1 → haystack.getD (i + j) 0 = needle.getD j 0
      rw [Bool.and_eq_true, ih]
      have hbeq :
          ((haystack.getD (i + k) 0 == needle.getD k 0) = true) ↔
            haystack.getD (i + k) 0 = needle.getD k 0 := by
        simp
      rw [hbeq]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hprev, hlast⟩ j hj
        by_cases h : j = k
        · subst j
          exact hlast
        · have hlt : j < k := by omega
          exact hprev j hlt
      · intro hall
        constructor
        · intro j hj
          exact hall j (Nat.lt_trans hj (Nat.lt_succ_self k))
        · exact hall k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)

theorem matchAtBool_eq_true_iff (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) :
    matchAtBool haystack needle i = true ↔ aux_matches_at haystack needle i := by
  simp [matchAtBool, aux_matches_at, allBytesEq_eq_true_iff]

theorem aux_matches_at_iff_matches_at (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) :
    aux_matches_at haystack needle i ↔ matches_at haystack needle i := by
  rfl

lemma list_getD_mem_of_lt {α : Type} (l : List α) (i : Nat) (d : α)
    (h : i < l.length) : l.getD i d ∈ l := by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      have h0 : i < 0 := by simpa using h
      exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero i h0)
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          simp [List.getD]
      | succ i =>
          have hi : i < xs.length := Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h
          have hm : xs.getD i d ∈ xs := ih i hi
          simpa [List.getD, List.mem_cons] using
            (Or.inr hm : xs.getD i d = x ∨ xs.getD i d ∈ xs)

lemma list_exists_getD_eq_of_mem {α : Type} {x d : α} {l : List α}
    (hx : x ∈ l) : ∃ k, k < l.length ∧ l.getD k d = x := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp at hx
  | cons y ys ih =>
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at hx
      rcases hx with hxy | hxys
      · subst hxy
        exact ⟨0, by simp, by simp [List.getD]⟩
      · obtain ⟨k, hk, hget⟩ := ih hxys
        exact ⟨k + 1, by simpa using Nat.succ_lt_succ hk, by simpa [List.getD] using hget⟩

lemma toArray_getD_mem_of_lt {α : Type} (l : List α) (i : Nat) (d : α)
    (h : i < l.toArray.size) : l.toArray.getD i d ∈ l := by
  have h' : i < l.length := by
    simpa using h
  have hm := list_getD_mem_of_lt l i d h'
  simpa using hm

lemma exists_getD_toArray_eq_of_mem {α : Type} {x d : α} {l : List α}
    (hx : x ∈ l) : ∃ k, k < l.toArray.size ∧ l.toArray.getD k d = x := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hget⟩ := list_exists_getD_eq_of_mem (x := x) (d := d) hx
  exact ⟨k, by simpa using hk, by simpa using hget⟩

theorem naive_search_postcond_satisfied (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
